test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Feb, 2026 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following part of the Indian constitution deals with the Municipalities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Part – IXA**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Part IXA** was added to the **Constitution of India** through the **74th Constitutional Amendment Act** of **1992**, which came into force on **June 1, 1993**.
 
• This part deals exclusively with **Municipalities** (Urban Local Bodies) and contains provisions from **Article 243-P to Article 243-ZG**. ***Hence, the correct answer is Part – IXA.***
 
• The act gave **constitutional status** to municipalities, making them a part of the formal democratic structure of India and ensuring they are governed by mandatory constitutional provisions.
 
• Under this part, the **12th Schedule** was added to the Constitution, which specifies **18 functional items** that fall under the jurisdiction of municipalities, such as urban planning, regulation of land use, and public health.
 
• The amendment provides for three types of Municipalities: **Nagar Panchayats** for transitional areas, **Municipal Councils** for smaller urban areas, and **Municipal Corporations** for larger urban areas.
 
• It also mandates the **reservation of seats** for Scheduled Castes (SC) and Scheduled Tribes (ST) in proportion to their population, and **not less than one-third** of the total number of seats for **women**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Part XIV of the Indian Constitution:**

 
 
• This part covers **Services Under the Union and the States**, spanning from **Article 308 to Article 323**.
 
• It includes provisions related to the **All India Services**, recruitment, and conditions of service for persons serving the Union or a State.
 
• It also establishes the **Public Service Commissions** (UPSC and State PSCs) under **Articles 315 to 323**, ensuring independent recruitment for civil services.
 
 
 
• **Part XVII of the Indian Constitution:**
 
 
• This part deals with **Official Languages** and consists of **Articles 343 to 351**.
 
• It specifies **Hindi in Devanagari script** as the official language of the Union (**Article 343**) and contains provisions for regional languages and the language of the **Supreme Court and High Courts**.
 
• It also includes **Article 351**, which provides a directive for the **development and promotion of the Hindi language**.
 
 
 
• **Part XII of the Indian Constitution:**
 
 
• This part is titled **Finance, Property, Contracts, and Suits** and covers **Articles 264 to 300A**.
 
• It manages the **distribution of revenues** between the Union and the States, including the establishment of the **Finance Commission** under **Article 280**.
 
• Importantly, **Article 300A** was added to this part by the **44th Amendment Act, 1978**, which converted the **Right to Property** from a Fundamental Right into a **Legal Right**.
 
 
 
• **Part IX of the Indian Constitution:**
 
 
• Distinct from Part IXA, **Part IX** deals with the **Panchayats** (Rural Local Bodies).
 
• It was inserted by the **73rd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992**, and covers **Article 243 to Article 243-O**.
 
• It added the **11th Schedule** to the Constitution, containing **29 functional items** for rural self-governance.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **State Election Commission:** Under **Article 243-K and 243-ZA**, the superintendence, direction, and control of the preparation of electoral rolls and the conduct of all elections to the **Panchayats and Municipalities** are vested in the **State Election Commission**.
 
• **Duration:** Both Panchayats and Municipalities are provided a fixed **five-year term**. If dissolved earlier, elections must be held within **6 months** from the date of dissolution.
 
• **District Planning Committee:** **Article 243-ZD** mandates the constitution of a **District Planning Committee** in every state to consolidate the plans prepared by the Panchayats and the Municipalities in the district.
